content.name: Sinéad O'Sampla
profile: Software engineer with eight years of experience building data platforms and internal tooling for Irish and UK clients. Comfortable owning a service from design through to production support, and happiest when a messy problem turns into a small, well-tested system.

education.qualification: MSc in Data Science and Analytics
details: Dissertation: forecasting bus arrival times from open transport data

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Led the migration of the reporting platform from nightly batch jobs to an Airflow-orchestrated pipeline, cutting report latency from twelve hours to under one.
Designed and built a self-service data catalogue used by forty analysts across three client teams.
Introduced Terraform for all AWS infrastructure and reviewed every module change for the team.
Mentored two graduate engineers through their first year, including weekly pairing sessions.

experience.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Built and maintained ETL jobs in Python and SQL feeding a PostgreSQL warehouse for retail clients.
Containerised the legacy ingestion service and moved it to Kubernetes with zero downtime.
Wrote the on-call runbook that halved the mean time to recovery for ingestion failures.

experience.title: Graduate Developer
bullets: Developed internal web tools in Python for the operations team.
Automated the weekly billing reconciliation, replacing a manual spreadsheet process.
Took part in the graduate rotation across support, QA and development.

additional: Interests: sea swimming, hill walking, amateur radio
